note: The relationship model of the Service Mapping Workspace (dictionary and mandatory relationships), as data. Relationships are written parent -> child: the parent is the upstream CI. Only the classes the reports hold today; more can be added. Rule ids are the ones of the Workspace, so both projects can be compared. A Service Instance with Platform ticked (u_platform) is the class 'platform'. A relationship counts only when neither end is Retired.

environments.note: The environment of a Service Instance: its Environment field, else a trailing word of its name ('- TEST'), else production. Synonyms count as one.

dictionary.note: The process carries out the capability.
Type not agreed yet: not checked.
A process can use several applications, and the other way round.
The process is delivered through the Business Service.
Go through the Business Service and the Business Application.
dictionary.advice: Link the process to a Business Service or a Business Application instead.

dictionary.note: One Service Instance or Platform per environment.
A Business Application's only children are Service Instances.
dictionary.advice: Link it through the Service Instance.

dictionary.note: Services and offerings reach a Business Application through the Service Instance.
dictionary.advice: Link it through the Service Instance.

dictionary.note: A Business Service has at least one offering; each offering has exactly one Business Service.
A Business Service is never the parent of another Business Service.
The offering depends on the Service Instances that deliver it.
The Service Instance uses the Platform's data or technology: the Service Instance is the parent.
A Platform that depends on another Platform.
A runtime dependency between Service Instances.
A Platform is the child of the Service Instance that uses it. Confirm with the criticality owner before changing production, because criticality flows down.
dictionary.advice: Swap the direction: the Service Instance is the parent of the Platform.

dictionary.note: The Service Instance depends on its Application CIs and APIs.
